title: Prove a reproducible headless Java core and PDF runtime
delivery: Build a local Docker image that can load, inspect, save, and reload an anonymized portfolio and convert and extract a representative PDF without launching the desktop application.

title: Query holdings through the Linux launcher and configuration
delivery: Run a short-lived container command to inspect holdings in the selected supported portfolio with predictable paths, account selection, filters, sorting, and limits.

title: Query transaction history including dividend relevance
delivery: Inspect purchases, sales, and dividends across open and closed holdings while making ambiguous securities-account attribution visible.

title: Protect launch and upgrade attempts with retained backups
delivery: Protect the selected portfolio with due monthly backups at launch and exact pre-upgrade backups before actual upgrade attempts.

title: Validate and activate released wrapper/upstream pairs locally
delivery: Use --update to discover, build, validate, and automatically activate a released wrapper/upstream pair while preserving the selected portfolio and previous validated pair on failure.

title: Preview a manual purchase with validated decimal amounts
delivery: Preview a same-currency purchase of an existing security using resolved accounts and upstream financial models without recording financial changes.

title: Apply purchases with atomic replacement and daily protection
delivery: Record a validated purchase with --apply, preserving unrelated data and protected recovery state while refusing stale or unsafe writes.

title: Create a security explicitly when recording its first purchase
delivery: Preview and record a purchase that explicitly creates a required security while preserving existing definitions and avoiding ambiguous reuse.

title: Record partial and full sales with complete quantity-history validation
delivery: Preview and record sales, including backdated entries, only when the affected holding remains nonnegative throughout its entire quantity history.

title: Record security-associated dividends with fees and taxes
delivery: Preview and record dividend cash credits for an existing security without changing held quantity or holding last updated.

title: Record foreign-currency purchases, sales, and dividends
delivery: Preview and record manual foreign-currency transactions with explicit exchange information and preserved upstream currency/rate semantics.

title: Persist tested model migrations only with financial changes
delivery: Allow a financial command to apply a fixture-validated upstream model migration while clearly disclosing the output version and protecting the exact original state.

title: Preview a verified current-layout Smartbroker purchase PDF
delivery: Convert one supported purchase PDF headlessly and preview all recognized transactions with authoritative booked amounts and explicit missing-value supplementation.

title: Apply purchase PDFs with duplicate-safe bookkeeping and recovery
delivery: Apply all recognized purchases in one PDF together while skipping confirmed re-imports and requiring a document-wide override for every suspected duplicate.

title: Import verified current-layout Smartbroker sale PDFs
delivery: Preview and atomically apply supported sale statements with complete quantity-history validation and duplicate protection.

title: Import verified current-layout Smartbroker dividend PDFs
delivery: Preview and atomically apply supported dividend statements as security-associated cash credits without quantity changes.

title: Import foreign-currency and mixed-transaction Smartbroker PDFs
delivery: Import supported foreign-currency and mixed purchase/sale/dividend documents as one validated financial decision using stated exchange information.
